rawRules.name: Seed Mucolids
rawRules.description: Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, one unit with this ability can use it instead of making any attacks with its ranged weapons. rawRules.name: Hive Defences

units.name: Toxicrene

rawRules.name: Grasping Tendrils
rawRules.description: Each time an enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army with this ability is selected to Fall Back, you can roll one D6: on a 3+, that enemy unit must Remain Stationary instead.

rawRules.name: Hypertoxic Miasma (Aura)
rawRules.description: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on a 2-3, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

units.name: Trygon

rawRules.name: Subterranean Tunnels
